title: Artefact 4 on public data: PXD048216 (U. virens, S-palmitoylation, ABE)
why: Artefact 4 is the last block with no public substitute.
NOT_BLIND_FOR: the headline coincidence: Stage C already computed 0.9418 (CAM-only) and 0.9643 (union) on this deposit before this file was written

definition_correction.found: Stage C expanded each site row to every listed protein but counted observed cysteines on the leading razor protein only; 1,721 of 3,398 CAM rows list several proteins; only 65.7% of site pairs were found among observed cysteines
definition_correction.primary: both sides on the leading assignment: observed = peptides.txt cysteine on Leading razor protein; site = (Protein, Position) of the site table row
definition_correction.secondary: Stage C's asymmetric definition, kept only for comparison

chemistry_from_methods.NEM: blocked free thiol carried through capture = detected-but-unmodified class
chemistry_from_methods.primary_reading: CAM-only; NEM-only, union and both also reported

enzyme_measured.measured: 98.98% of peptides end in K/R; 13 of 3,602 (0.36%) followed by P; missed cleavages 0/1/2 = 2871/728/72
enzyme_measured.consequence: proline-blocked trypsin, matching the manuscript's rule

quantities.Q1: coincidence p with Wilson interval and protein-clustered bootstrap (5000, seed 20260921)
quantities.Q2: count and share of observed cysteines with no CAM site = the unmodified class
quantities.Q3: detectability calibration: sensitivity and PPV of the in-silico rule (7-30 aa, <=2 missed); length 6-35 as sensitivity
quantities.Q4: multi-cysteine observed/expected by cysteine count 1..4, DESCRIPTIVE ONLY
quantities.Q5: PRE-DECLARED PREDICTION: mixed CAM+NEM multi-cysteine peptides EXIST in non-trivial number under ABE, the opposite of a peptide-level tethering mechanism

mechanism_does_not_transfer: a maleimide-biotin, peptide-level capture mechanism is workflow-specific; ABE labels at the protein level after NEM blocking. Q4/Q5 are a mechanism CONTRAST, not a replication, and the manuscript paragraph must be rewritten, not migrated

branches_Q1.K-HIGH: Wilson lower bound of CAM-only p >= 0.90 -> near-unity coincidence replicates
branches_Q1.K-MID: 0.50 <= L < 0.90 -> a coincidence exists but the unmodified class is not negligible; 'cannot be constructed' becomes 'is small'
branches_Q1.K-LOW: L < 0.50 -> does not replicate; Artefact 4 narrowed or withdrawn. THIS CONTRADICTS THE MANUSCRIPT AND WE PUBLISH IT.
branches_Q1.why_0.90: the level at which fewer than one observed cysteine in ten is unmodified; NOT taken from 0.9923 or from the Stage C values seen earlier

controls.PC1: Amino acid column 100% C in both site tables
controls.PC2: observed-cysteine count under the SECONDARY definition equals Stage C's 3,554
controls.PC3: peptides.txt protein ids resolve in the FASTA for >= 90% of proteins, else the calibration is not run
controls.NC1: within-protein position permutation (seed 20260921) must drop the coincidence well below the observed one; otherwise the quantity is not measuring site identity

not_done_this_round: seven-feature A/B contrast (needs AlphaFold-derived features; v6 files retrievable)
if Part 2 is not run these two elements must be deleted
PXD054433: NOT the input arm (raw files differ: WT1/WT2 vs nine 169-61-* files); not used
limitations: two biological replicates: report per replicate
the same QUESTION on public data, not a replication of earlier numbers
